character_functions.covering_map: the point (component, t) of an arc covers the point of G's component of the same id at the angle omega = 2 pi t mod 2 pi (folded into G's range), a point x of an atom G's point x mod pi; a vector family's character is Rotation's, its variable phi = 2 psi

matrices.basis: spherical: the kets |j,m> of D^(j,+1) (double/CONVENTIONS.md section 26.1), m = j, j-1, ..., -j; partner mu = j - m + 1

iCphi.diag: p exp(2i m x), m = j, ..., -j

euler.relation: for U = R~_z(alpha) R~_y(beta) R~_z(gamma) (the lifts of section 21.1, product in the order of SU(2) matrices), D^j(U)_{m'm} = exp(-i m' alpha) d^j_{m'm}(beta) exp(-i m gamma), d^j the Wigner d matrix of SU2's wigner_d

su2.relation: hat D(U, eps)_{m'm} = p^[eps = -1] conj(D^j(U)_{m m'}) (double/CONVENTIONS.md section 26.1), D^j(U)_{m'm} = sqrt((j+m')! (j-m')! (j+m)! (j-m)!) sum_k a^k b^(j+m'-k) c^(j+m-k) d^(k-m-m') / (k! (j+m'-k)! (j+m-k)! (k-m-m')!), over the k for which every factorial argument is >= 0; U = [[a, b], [c, d]] in SU(2); D^j(U) is the matrix of U on the polynomials u^(j+m) v^(j-m) / sqrt((j+m)! (j-m)!) under u -> a u + c v, v -> b u + d v, and D^(1/2)(U) = U; p the parity of the family (+1 for Dhalf and Dhalfg, -1 for Dhalfu)

rules: Pin^-(3): (U, -1) acts on every product ket of D^(j1,p1) (x) D^(j2,p2) as p1 p2 times (U, +1), whose action is D^j1(U)^dagger (x) D^j2(U)^dagger, so the coupled kets carry the parity p1 p2 and <j1 m1, p1; j2 m2, p2 | J M, p> = delta_{p,p1 p2} <j1 m1 j2 m2 | J M>: the coefficients are SU2's (table)

jj_configurations.rule: Lambda^n of the spinor level L, n = 0, ..., dim L: chi = e_n(g), n e_n = sum_{k=1}^{n} (-1)^(k-1) e_(n-k) chi_L(g^k); Lambda^(d-n)(L) = Lambda^n(L) (x) Lambda^d(L)

spin_orbitals.parity_rule: the states of SU2's spin_orbitals: |l j m> carries D^(j,(-1)^l) of Pin^-(3), the parity of the orbital

closed_form.parity_rule: D^(J,-1)|2G = (D^(J,+1)|2G) (x) det: at parity -1 a block keeps its kets and partners, its label g becomes u
closed_form.structure_theorem: D^(J,p)|SU(2) = D^(J) (Pin^-(3): D^(J,p)): the 2J+1 kets |J,m> are the partners of one block, mu = J - m + 1

continuous.text: D^(J,p) | 2C_infh = sum_{n=1/2..J} (1E_n,x + 2E_n,x), x = g if p = +1, u if p = -1
D^(J,p) | 2C_infv = sum_{n=1/2..J} E_n for both p
D^(J,p) | 2D_inf = sum_{n=1/2..J} E_n for both p
D^(J,p) | 2D_infh = sum_{n=1/2..J} E_n,x, x = g if p = +1, u if p = -1
D^(J,p) | SU(2) = D^(J) for both p

families.text: D^(J,p) | 2C_N = SU(2)'s rule for both p
D^(J,p) | 2S_2N (N odd) = sum_{m=-J..J} G(q),x, q = m mod N, G(q) as for 2C_N, x = g if p = +1, u if p = -1
D^(J,p) | 2S_2N (N even) = sum_{m=-J..J} G, q = m + N[p = -1] mod 2N; G = 1E_{min(q,2N-q)} if q mod N < N/2, 2E_{min(q,2N-q)} if q mod N > N/2
D^(J,p) | 2C_Nh (N odd) = sum_{m=-J..J} E_{min(q,2N-q)}x, q = m + N[p = -1] mod 2N, x = ' if p (-1)^(m-1/2) = +1, '' if it is -1
D^(J,p) | 2C_Nh (N even) = sum_{m=-J..J} G(q),x, q = m mod N, G(q) as for 2C_N, x = g if p = +1, u if p = -1
D^(J,p) | 2C_Nv = sum_{m=1/2..J} G(q), q = m mod N, G(q) as for 2D_N, for both p
D^(J,p) | 2D_N = SU(2)'s rule for both p
D^(J,p) | 2D_Nh (N odd) = sum_{m=1/2..J} E_{min(q,2N-q)}, q = m + N[p = -1] mod 2N
D^(J,p) | 2D_Nh (N even) = 2D_N's terms, each with ,g if p = +1, ,u if p = -1
D^(J,p) | 2D_Nd (N odd) = 2D_N's terms, each with ,g if p = +1, ,u if p = -1
D^(J,p) | 2D_Nd (N even) = sum_{m=1/2..J} E_{min(q,2N-q)}, q = m + N[p = -1] mod 2N

subduction_rules.parity: the generating functions count the blocks at p = +1, as the members' records; at p = -1 the multiplicity of L is that of L (x) det, det the determinant character of the subgroup
subduction_rules.sections: a section over C_N or S_2N (N odd) is restricted as its preimage, each spinor irrep renamed by the section's record (double/CONVENTIONS.md section 27)
